reviews.title: Free ??!!!!
reviews.text: It said it’s a free option but it doesn’t really exist when you create the account the option are to pay!!!

reviews.title: Es excelente
reviews.text: Es una excelente aplicación, realmente te lleva de la mano a conseguir tus metas siempre y cuando uno sea constante y comprometido, a mi me ha dado excelentes resultados, y la atención à afiliados es rápida y excelente . Gracias PlateLens

reviews.title: 100% worth it
reviews.text: So easy to use, I used to have MyFitnessPal but couldn’t be consistent. Platelens has helped me lose weight no regrets!!

reviews.title: Fantastic!
reviews.text: This app is incredibly helpful. I can track my calories, macros, water intake, and steps all in one place.  The photo option is incredibly helpful and easy to edit if necessary. Customer service was fantastic as well when I had a question.

reviews.title: Parlor Trick more than tech
reviews.text: This app is more of a parlor than technology.  The barcode scans often don’t match calories on packaging (even simple popular ones).  The plain language doesn’t pick up nuances like brand.  The photo recognition translates into highly generic descriptions even when it’s clearly possible to use the AI to find the more exact calories.  If you care about precision, this app isn’t ready yet.

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text:
I downloaded the app five days ago and started using it right away. I really tried to like it, but so far, I’m honestly surprised by all the great reviews I’ve seen because, for some reason, I just don’t see it.
It takes longer than other apps to log food items, and even when I take pictures of nutrition labels, the app often changes the macros to something completely different, even though the information is clearly stated on the label. I don’t understand why this happens.
At this point, I feel like I could use CalAI and get much faster and more accurate results. Unfortunately I was charged already for a yearly membership and at this point I hope I would be able to get my money back.

reviews.title: My favorite calorie tracker
reviews.text: This is my favorite calorie tracker. I find it super useful and accurate, and completely love the AI Coach. Great.

reviews.title: Flexible, comprehensive nutrition tracker and coach
reviews.text: I was looking for a tool that provides flexibility in terms of tracking - based on photo, verbal input, manual input, along with ability to subsequently edit the components.  I’m constantly impressed with its ability to discern all elements from the photo, as well as to adjust on the fly based on a comment like “only ate 2/3 of …” - AI Coach can be configured to meet your preferences.  Very educational, and I expect it to prove to be a key partner along this journey.

reviews.title: Free version
reviews.text: Not free!  Also, you do have to provide a credit card and choose a plan that doesn’t include “free.”  Totally false representation.

reviews.title: False advertised price!
reviews.text:
When I first install this app as a trial, it said that it would only be $6.99/mo which I was cool with. The issue arose when they took out the first payment of almost $80! A full year upfront!!!
Now, I was under the assumption that it was the advertise price and now it has put me in a debt with Apple to where I can’t even update a simple app. I’ve tried to contact the customer service and gotten no response.
I even added my account on the cancellation day and was still charged. When I try and cancel it now it says I can’t cancel until next year. That’s some sketchy stuff….

reviews.title: Great idea, but not reliable enough for the price
reviews.text:
I really wanted to like Plate Lens and paid around $80 specifically for the “ease of tracking.” Unfortunately, I’ve had to constantly double-check or manually enter information.

A 200-calorie bar scanned as 104 calories, while another food showed 220 instead of 130. Some products aren't in the database at all. Photo tracking doesn't let me adjust individual ingredients, only the entire meal. The app has also shown me at 87% of my calorie goal while the Coach said I was 680 calories over.

I also entered dairy as a dietary restriction, yet the Coach recommended Greek yogurt.

A 3-day trial wasn't enough time to discover these issues. When I requested a refund, it was denied and I was instead asked to extensively document the problems for their development team.

There are great ideas here, but for someone seriously tracking calories/macros, I don't think it's reliable enough yet—especially at this price.

reviews.title: Better apps available for less
reviews.text: Still struggling to do the most basic of things. Significant issues with scanning barcodes. The AI fix/ edit will out right ignore your input 75% of the time. Most of the barcode scans that found the product, assumed I was consuming the entire package. Like an entire bottle of coffee creamer, or whole entire package of sliced cheese. Broken concept of servings even if you take a picture of the nutrition label. SMH.

reviews.title: Very Great Free Option
reviews.text: Honestly not too much to complain about since the app is free. It does suck that there is a daily limit of 2 for the manual type up and photo scan, but at least you can log previous meals.

reviews.title: Very inaccurate
reviews.text: This app is pretty terrible. Using the barcode scanner, it finds things but the nutritional info is completely wrong. Even if it’s right, after adding the food to a meal, it completely changes the nutritional info it initially showed. I didn’t even try the AI scanner but if the barcode scanner is this bad I have no faith in the ai image scanner

reviews.title: Accuracy
reviews.text: I like the interface of the app and the fact that I can enter manually, however the Ai photo feature is very inaccurate, only gets it right if you weight it correctly. For some reason chat got told me at some point it’s the most accurate app but it’s not saying that anymore lol

reviews.title: All around great app!
reviews.text:
This is the most accurate ai calorie tracker on the market. It has everything you could want, calorie counting, macro tracking, fasting timer, water intake reminders, a surprisingly good ai coach, and plenty more.

 I enjoy the manual entry and voice entry over the photo tool! (Nothing wrong with the photo tool, I just like typing what I’m cooking as I go) The daily score is a great way to keep tabs on your overall eating habits for the day, it has been great motivation! 

To add to the great app, the customer support is truly second to none. I reached out regarding special discounts. Not only did they accommodate the discount. They responded quickly and were more than helpful with all my questions and needs! 

I hope they keep this app going strong! I could really see this taking over the calorie counting market!

reviews.title: Dissatisfied and being refused correspondence about a refund.
reviews.text: I am extremely dissatisfied with the PlateLens customer service. I have emailed support 3 times and have not received a single response, despite the website promising a response within 24 hours. The $80 charge for a year subscription went through without the promised notification at the end of the free trial. I would like to be refunded as I am dissatisfied the accuracy of the app and with my experience and do not want the year subscription.

reviews.title: So disappointing
reviews.text: I found this app and was so excited to be able to log my food from a photo. It was frustrating right from the start. It would not let me accurately log my current weight or my goal weight. I could go a pound or 2 up or a pound or 2 down. Then the app glitched and did not save so I had to start my profile all over. I then snapped my first meal- bacon and eggs. Easy enough, right?  Nope, it calculated 407 calories when the actual total was 286. I don’t expect an exact science but a difference of 121 calories is quite a bit for 2 items widely known items. I found the AI coach annoying. So it’s been deleted.

reviews.title: Such a very reasonable app too literally have in yo pocket.
Great app but I would humbly request two things
reviews.text: I switched from CalAI to this based on accuracy ratings.  I feel it is way more accurate.  I would like to see a larger database for the barcode scanner as about half the time it says product not found.  These were simple scans like Almonds or a small cup of Häagen-Dazs.  Not very exotic items.  What I would like to see the ability to take an “after” picture of my meal.  I seldom finish the whole thing and it would be cool to show how much was left and have the app deduct those calories.  Thank you.

reviews.title: Generally Inaccurate
reviews.text: I’m disappointed that every time I scan a barcode, the exact nutritional information does not come up and I often have to edit it. I also find the calorie burning widget to calculate erroneously.

reviews.title: Frustrating
reviews.text: There has not been a single instance where I’ve logged a meal or an exercise without needing to manually correct or recalculate the information provided. I chose this app to simplify tracking my calorie deficit, but instead, I find myself putting in more effort than when I was using much more basic tools. I emailed customer support and have not received and response or resolution.

reviews.title: Great)
reviews.text: It definitely changes my eating habits and helps me genuinely so much on my mental eating! I used to binge eat a bunch of garbage every day now I can genuinely prep my food take photos and use it to help count everything. Unfortunately the only downside is I have to pay for it sadly..

reviews.title: Great App! Changed the way I think about eating
reviews.text: This helped me to learn more about nutritional composition of food and the importance of not only total calories but grams of protein, carbs etc to stay healthy! Love the coach feature too, it helps me to stay on track daily.

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: PlateLens is such a helpful and easy to use app. I love how much information I get just from taking a quick picture of my food. It saves me so much time and makes tracking what I eat simple and stress-free. Everything works smoothly and is easy to understand right away. Highly recommend
